elements.description:
The action bar under an AI chat message: copy, regenerate with a version switcher, thumbs with a feedback row, and
read aloud.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The message text – copied to the clipboard by Copy and used to time Read aloud

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Which actions to show, in this order

properties.name: versions
properties.description: All versions of the message, or just how many there are. From 2 on the version switcher shows

properties.name: version
properties.description: The shown version (0-based); unset, the bar keeps it, starting at `defaultVersion` and jumping to new versions

properties.name: defaultVersion
properties.description: Starting version while `version` is unset – defaults to the newest

properties.name: onRegenerate
properties.description:
Called when Regenerate is pressed – add a version and the switcher jumps to it. Return a promise to keep the arrow
spinning until it settles; a rejection says "Couldn't regenerate". `signal` aborts when the element is removed

properties.name: regenerating
properties.description: Keeps the regenerate arrow spinning while a new version is written

properties.name: onFeedback
properties.type: ((kind: FeedbackKind | null, reason?: string) => void | Promise<unknown>) | undefined
properties.description:
Called with "up" or "down" when a thumb is pressed, null when it is taken back, and "down" with a reason when the
feedback row is sent. Sending may return a promise: "Thanks!" shows once it resolves, a rejection lets you send again

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: The vote: "up", "down" or null for none. Unset, the bar keeps it, starting at `defaultFeedback`

properties.name: defaultFeedback
properties.description: The vote to start with while `feedback` is unset

properties.name: reasons
properties.description: Quick reasons in the feedback row. "Other" opens a small text field

properties.name: ownSpeech
properties.description:
Set when you play the audio yourself (listen to tc-speak): the bar then doesn't read `text` with the browser's
speech synthesis. Without it (and without `speaking`) the browser reads `text`; where there is none, reading is
simulated (and warns once, unless `demo` is set)

properties.name: speaking
properties.description: Controlled playing state, e.g. tied to your speech player

properties.name: speakDuration
properties.description: How long an uncontrolled read aloud plays when it isn't the browser speaking, in ms – defaults to an estimate from `text`

properties.name: demo
properties.description: Demo mode: Read aloud is simulated silently where it would be simulated. For galleries and prototypes

properties.name: quiet
properties.description: Lighter icons until the message is hovered (default true; quiet="false" turns it off). Put data-ui-message on the message wrapper

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name of the bar

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-version-change
events.description: A version was picked in the switcher; detail `{ version: number }` (0-based). Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the shown version (controlled use)

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: `text` is on the clipboard (or Copy was pressed without `text`); detail `{ text?: string }`

events.name: tc-feedback
events.description: A thumb was pressed or taken back, or the feedback row was sent; detail `{ feedback: "up" | "down" | null, reason?: string }`

events.name: tc-speak
events.description: Read aloud started or stopped; detail `{ playing: boolean }`

elements.description:
The message itself, crossfading when `version` changes: the old content fades out underneath while the new one fades
in, and the block eases to its new height.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Which version is shown – a change crossfades

properties.name: content
properties.description: The message: text, or an element (cloned; changes inside it are followed)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

props.name: onVersionChange
props.description: Called with the version index picked in the switcher

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called once `text` is on the clipboard (or right away when there's no `text`). "Copied" shows only after a successful write

props.name: onSpeak
props.description:
Called with true when Read aloud starts and false when it stops – play your audio here. Without it (and without
`speaking`) the browser's speech synthesis reads `text`

changelog: `tc-conversation-branches` – edit a past message to fork the conversation; a 2 / 3 switcher on the edited message, each branch's replies (with `tc-message-actions`) below, and `tc-edit` answered with the new replies or a promise of them.
